entries.clue: Craftsman who pares a horse's feet and nails the plates on
Untanned cow's skin, salted and stacked, bound for the tannery vats
Open metal basket of hot coals, warming a night watchman
Officer who seized goods for unpaid debts, hated in every village
Mendicant brother in a rope-belted habit; Tuck is the famously stout one
Man-high English war weapon of Agincourt, drawn right back to the ear
Needle-slim high heel named for a slender dagger
Narrow band crossing the foot that keeps a sandal from slipping off
Monastic superior outranking a prior, and a stock villain of the old tales
Pointed steel spike a shoemaker pushes through a sole to start a stitch
Wheezing bag squeezed to drive a blast of air into the fire
